chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a Moroccan man around 30, short black hair, neatly trimmed short beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and grey joggers
chars.EXWIFE: EXWIFE: a Moroccan woman in her late 20s, long wavy dark-brown hair, wearing a burgundy satin blouse, black trousers and gold hoop earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook illustration. Night, small modern apartment living room in Casablanca. NARRATOR sits up suddenly on a beige sofa, eyes wide and eyebrows raised in surprise, staring at his glowing smartphone that just buzzed with a message from an unknown number. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible and lit by the phone. Calm dark background at the edges. No text, no letters on the screen.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook illustration. Close-up over the shoulder of NARRATOR holding his phone at night; the screen shows a chat bubble from an anonymous grey silhouette profile picture (no readable text, only blurry shapes). His face in three-quarter view, frowning, curious and suspicious. Warm lamp light, cozy Moroccan apartment blurred behind.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook illustration. NARRATOR leans forward on the sofa, typing fast with both thumbs, mouth slightly open, nervous sweat drop on his forehead, comic tension. Phone glow on his face. Living room at night with a Moroccan pouf and a low table with a tea glass. No text anywhere.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook illustration. NARRATOR stands up in the middle of the living room reading his phone, hand on his head in disbelief, jaw dropping, as several message bubbles (blank shapes, no text) float around him like a storm. Comic exaggerated expression. Head-to-knee framing, centered.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook illustration. Inside a dim trendy shisha lounge in a Moroccan city with purple neon glow and cushioned benches, EXWIFE sits relaxed and laughing, holding a hookah hose and blowing a big cloud of smoke, carefree. Seen like a slightly blurry secretly taken photo from across the room. Head-to-waist framing, face visible. No text or signs with letters.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook illustration. NARRATOR sitting on the floor of his living room with his back against the sofa, holding the phone close to his face, eyes huge and bulging, comically shocked, one hand covering his mouth. Phone light on his face, a tea glass knocked over beside him. No text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook illustration. NARRATOR sits at a small kitchen table at night, phone lying face down in front of him, thinking hard with a sad frown, chin resting on his fist, half his face lit by a hanging lamp. Moroccan zellige tiles on the wall behind. Calm, reflective mood.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook illustration. Early morning, NARRATOR stands on a small balcony overlooking Casablanca rooftops with satellite dishes, sunlight on his face, eyes closed, exhaling with a relieved small smile, hands open. Peaceful mood, soft sky.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook illustration. EXWIFE, now wearing a beige hijab over the same burgundy satin blouse, sits on a bed holding her phone up and posting, with an exaggerated innocent saintly expression, eyes looking upward, a prayer rug folded beside her. Cozy bedroom in a Moroccan house. Comic ironic mood. No text.
